# Local patch — stale-ctx warning suppression (2026-10-17)

## Symptom
`Warning: Observational memory: observer failed: This extension ctx is stale after
session replacement or reload. ...` — surfaced when a session replacement/reload
(running the consolidation pipeline across `/new`, `/reload`, session switch) raced
with the async worker stages.

## Root cause
`src/runtime.ts` (plus `src/hooks/compaction-trigger.ts`) treated pi's
context-staleness guard error as a normal stage failure:
- `Runtime.recordConsolidationStageError()` warned `Observational memory: <phase>
  failed: <pi stale text>` — the reported message.
- `Runtime.launchTrackedTask()` warned `... consolidation failed: <pi stale text>`.
- `hooks/compaction-trigger.ts` deferred `setTimeout` path warned
  `... compact threw: <pi stale text>` when `ctx.isIdle()` threw after replacement.

## Fix (files patched in place)
- `src/runtime.ts`: added `isStaleCtxError()` (matches pi's
  `This extension ctx is stale after session replacement or reload` signature) and
  `safeNotify()` (never throws); stale stage errors are recorded as
  `<phase> cancelled (session replaced or reloaded mid-run)` and only debug-logged —
  no toast (the session that would receive it is gone).
- `src/hooks/compaction-trigger.ts`: same stale guard in the deferred-compaction
  catch and `onError` paths.

## Files (in this folder)
- `runtime.ts.bak-stale-ctx-fix`         — ORIGINAL (pre-patch)
- `runtime.ts.patched-stale-ctx-fix`     — PATCHED snapshot
- `hooks/compaction-trigger.ts.bak-stale-ctx-fix`    — ORIGINAL (pre-patch)
- `hooks/compaction-trigger.ts.patched-stale-ctx-fix` — PATCHED snapshot

## Re-apply after `pi update --extensions` (which restores upstream files)
```powershell
$p = "$HOME\.pi\agent\npm\node_modules\pi-observational-memory\src"
Copy-Item "$p\runtime.ts.patched-stale-ctx-fix" "$p\runtime.ts" -Force
Copy-Item "$p\hooks\compaction-trigger.ts.patched-stale-ctx-fix" "$p\hooks\compaction-trigger.ts" -Force
```
then restart pi (or `/reload`).

## Validation used (2026-10-17)
- esbuild parse of both files (pi loads extensions transpile-only, esbuild).
- `npx --yes -p typescript@5.7.3 tsc -p <pkg>/tsconfig.stalecheck.json`
  (temp tsconfig: module/moduleResolution nodenext, skipLibCheck) → only the 5
  PRE-EXISTING upstream errors (agents/*, consolidation-trigger.ts), 0 in patched files.
- 23-assertion behavior test (esbuild-bundled, stubbed pi package): stale stage error
  -> no toast + friendly record; real failures still warn exactly as before; stale ctx
  read during notify does not throw; compaction trigger stale path silent + flag reset,
  control path still warns.

Upstream: https://github.com/elpapi42/pi-observational-memory (v3.1.4) — worth
reporting so the fix survives updates.
